summary: Marylebone has 213 Google reviews at 5 stars, a clear new patient offer and a fees page. Stale notices, empty media slots and small errors reduce the impact of strong proof.

findings.problem: A Christmas notice still says the clinic will open on 5th January 2026. The page also shows Last Updated on August 3, 2026.
findings.cost: An out of date holiday notice tells a patient that nobody is looking after the site, and they may doubt whether the clinic is currently open.
findings.fix: Current notices and a single accurate last updated date.

findings.problem: Three video slots, the quote graphic and the before and after images load as empty placeholders as I saw them, and stray labels such as Top show.
findings.cost: Implant patients look for real results and real people. Empty media slots hide the proof you already have.
findings.fix: Working videos, captioned before and after cases and a clean page with no stray labels.

findings.problem: Email addresses show as [email protected] when scripts do not run. The BOOK AN APPOINTMENT button goes to a different page than the other booking links.
findings.cost: A patient who cannot see an email or is sent to different booking pages hesitates, and a callback request delays the booking.
findings.fix: A visible email, one booking path and real time booking with confirmation.

findings.problem: Typos and inconsistency: incredible happy, Dr.Santos, Teeth in a Day and teeth-in-a-day, and Dental Implants London repeated so often it reads as keyword stuffing.
findings.cost: Small errors and repeated keywords weaken trust, and patients who prefer messaging have no route.
findings.fix: A proofread build with natural copy and WhatsApp as a second route.

redesign: A proof first homepage that puts your 213 reviews, fees and real results beside every booking button.
One clear booking path with WhatsApp, so a patient books in under 30 seconds.
